direction: Extend the globally scale-normalized generalized savings score into a two-term family: (a) keep the scale-invariant radial savings core s_ij = (d0i + d0j - lam*dij + mu*|d0i - d0j|) / mean(d[0,1:]) with lam in [1.00,1.15], mu in [0.08,0.15], and (b) strengthen the dimensionless capacity-packing channel toward tight-capacity regimes by scoring post-merge fill fill_ij = clip((qi+qj)/Q,0,1) with a boosted beta in [0.10,0.30] plus a residual-slack penalty -gamma*clip((Q-(qi+qj))/Q,0,1) and an endpoint demand-imbalance term delta*(1-|qi-qj|/(qi+qj)). All terms remain dimensionless and scale-invariant (1e-3 rescale => 0.00% drift), computed in one fully vectorized pass before the merge loop so hook_ms stays < 0.5 ms and the 25 ms budget is never exhausted. No postprocess, to keep the pure constructive effect measurable.

operations.mechanism: The L2a entry confirms the scale-normalized generalized savings family (dev_24 16.1398–16.1595, 100% completion at both 500 ms and 25 ms) is the correct backbone and that per-pair normalization is an anti-pattern that destroys radial priority ordering; we therefore keep the single global scale denominator and only mutate the dimensionless capacity channel. Archive feedback shows the current SBS at 16.1275 with VBS gap only 0.46%, so gains must come from regime-specific weakness: tight capacity and n=100 clustered instances where fragmented tail routes dominate. The L2b entry documents that dynamic candidate refresh costs ~3.7x p95 latency and caused budget exhaustion at 25 ms, so we deliberately stay on the static one-shot vectorized hook and keep postprocess 'none' rather than risking 25 ms exhaustion with relocate_2opt. Expected outcome: modest but non-degrading improvement concentrated on the tight/100/clustered strata while preserving the ~2 ms mean solve time.

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: On cvrp_dev_hetero_24 at the 25 ms budget, the current leader (16.1275) is limited by tail-trip fragmentation under tight capacity (vbs_rel_gap -22.02% on capacity_level=tight, -20.81% on size=100); adding a boosted dimensionless merge-fill reward with a residual-slack penalty and endpoint demand-imbalance term on top of the scale-normalized radial savings core will reduce the number of residual near-empty routes and lower mean tour length below 16.1275 without increasing hook cost beyond ~0.5 ms, so no budget-exhaustion degradation occurs.
